The old deadline precision group currently has 3 fixture/constructor failures and 2 passes. Its missing acceptance-window input and old constructor call remain unreconciled and are not counted as product proof.
A 19-case coordinator aggregate had 1 intermediate rebuttal projection failure and 18 passes; the corrected coordinator group passed 24. The overlapping all-native group passed 32.

The pre-isolation-fix live group passed 37 but wrote service log entries through an ordinary relative path; it is behavior evidence, not an isolated gate. T-179 reproduced both log-path gaps with 2 failures and T-180 passed 2 focused cases after binding both paths under tmp_path.
The corrected isolated live group passed the same 37 cases in 34.76 seconds. A read-only 41-file ordinary-log snapshot had zero missing or changed files afterward.

The final unit/architecture aggregate passed 136 cases, including 26 architecture cases. Final statics report Ruff clean, Mypy clean across 34 source files and project Pyright at zero errors. These scopes overlap earlier groups and are not added together.
